title: CodeFlow SlicedPayload (Slice -> Fusion contract)
$comment: Ticket 02. Stage 2 Structural Slice output; language-neutral input to Stage 3 Semantic Fusion.
description: Determinism (normative): identical input bytes + slice opts + profile version + adapter/schema version MUST reproduce a byte-identical SlicedPayload — the slice cache key is exactly that tuple, so any semantic difference must be a schema-visible field. Traversal rules encoded here: import-resolved direct references are followed across files (resolved_cross_file), dynamic/type-unresolved calls become unknown_edge cards and are NOT followed, boundary markers (Repository/ApiClient) terminate traversal as boundary_call cards, depth <= 5 with visited-set cycle blocking and truncated flag on overflow. Secret redaction (normative): every string leaving the adapter passes the common secret scanner; redactedCount records how many secret matches were replaced by '***REDACTED***' (0 = clean payload).

language.description: Target language of the source slice.

kind.description: Structural kinds from AST statement slicing.

effectTarget.description: Boundary/system target of an effect step (e.g. repository method).

toSymbolPath.description: Best-known target reference; for unknown_edge this is the unresolved call site description rather than a verified symbol.

depth.description: Traversal depth at which this edge was recorded; hard cap 5 per draft-spec inheritance.

stepOrdinal.description: OPTIONAL: 1-based ordinal of the step that produced this edge, letting consumers attach the delegation target to the right timeline card.

truncated.description: True when depth cap or denylist stopped traversal before exhaustion; consumers must surface truncation.

visitedCycleDetected.description: True when the visited-set blocked a call cycle during traversal.

redactedCount.description: Count of secret scanner matches replaced with '***REDACTED***'; >0 means redaction actually occurred, 0 means the payload was clean. Values are never negative.
